notice: This fixture defines expected security findings for evaluation purposes. It is NOT raw scanner output.

target_cves.title: Interrupted initialization after memory exhaustion (PHP hash table RCE)
Stale state crosses request boundaries (Use-After-Free RCE in upload progress / backtraces)

vulnerable_container_image.evaluation_criterion: A container-aware scanner with an up-to-date advisory feed must identify both CVEs based on the Alpine PHP 8.3.35 binary/package.

patched_container_image.evaluation_criterion: Neither CVE should be reported. Any finding against PHP 8.3.36 represents a false positive.

repository_manifest_sca.evaluation_criterion: Core PHP runtime vulnerabilities cannot be identified through Composer library dependencies alone. Absence of detection in manifest SCA reflects an architectural scope boundary, not a scanner flaw.
